summary: AFP Advisory Group (AFP Accounting, Tax & Business Advisory) is a Sydney firm headquartered in Norwest, serving high-net-worth family groups and medium-scale enterprises, with a Virtual CFO line and a finance and loans division. Alex Flyak has been Managing Partner since 2014. The team is very small (about 5 on LinkedIn) and part of the bookkeeping workforce is in the Philippines. Recent LinkedIn posts cover the 2026-27 Budget and business lending.

hooks.text: Virtual CFO offering rests on management reporting; part of the bookkeeping team is offshore in the Philippines, so review of reconciliations is a likely time sink (inference).
May 2026 LinkedIn posts on the Budget and on lender expectations (cash flow sustainability) show the firm talks to clients about cash flow and structuring.
Alex's stated interest in developing future leaders may suit a pitch about freeing junior staff from manual reconciling.

risks.text: Very small team (5 on LinkedIn, shrinking) and HNW/tax/structuring focus; weak volume fit for reconciliation tooling.
Offshore bookkeeping may mean reconciliations are handled by a BPO provider who might not adopt new tools.

gaps: No blog posts or podcast appearances by Alex found beyond the firm's news page.
No public job ads found; careers page lists no open roles.
Tech stack (Xero/MYOB) only from an aggregator, not AFP itself.
